propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline without systematic coupling to the registry, so a criterion's rubric can be rewritten silently and every prose paraphrase of it becomes outdated.
The gate must fail when a cited criterion's text changes, forcing re-verification of the guide's claim about it and regeneration of a pin digest to reflect the new authoritative text.
Criterion id citations in prose guides must be extracted by closed vocabulary matching at word boundaries with no structural markup dependence, so ordinary prose edits do not break the gate.
The pin manifest must be generated over packaged built-in criteria only and regenerated in place alongside the guides it pins, with validation composed into the existing validate-routing step.
Stale pins, unknown citations, orphan pins, and missing manifests must each be reported distinctly with the remedy and citing guide or criterion named.
